stories.headline: Carney unveils $6.6B 'Buy Canadian' defence industrial strategy to reduce US reliance
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a new Defence Industrial Strategy promising $6.6 billion in investment, 125,000 new jobs over 10 years, and plans to increase Canadian firms' share of defence contracts from 30% to 70%. The strategy aims to reduce dependence on US suppliers.
